name: img2threejs
title_zh: 拒绝贴图骗人的代码建模，从参考图长出可动三维骨架
tagline_zh: 拿一张角色或物件参考图，它分步生成带质量门槛的 Three.js 程序化模型。不是照片级渲染，是能进动画管线。
tagline_en: Feed it one reference image; get a staged, quality-gated Three.js model built in code—real geometry for.
desc_en: Turn an object or character reference image into a quality-gated, animation-ready procedural Three.js model built in code. Use for image-to-3D reconstruction, detail-accurate object rebuilds, stylized/likeness-maximized human characters, sculpt specs, and staged code generation.
why_zh: 它把「像不像」拆成可验收的中间产物，每步卡质量线，最后交付的是可编辑代码而非黑盒网格。
why_en: It turns likeness into staged, quality-gated checkpoints—delivering editable code, not a black-box mesh, so you tweak the.
limit_zh: 只认单张正/侧参考图，多视角或透视强烈会失真；产出是低模风格化几何，不做PBR材质烘焙；复杂机械结构需手动拆件。
limit_en: Single front/side reference only; strong perspective or multi-view fails. Output is stylized low-poly, no PBR baking; complex mechanics need manual.
title_en: Code-built 3D from one image, animation-ready, no texture.
